end.summary:
Practised naming cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere.
Matched cake tin, dice, matchbox, pencil box, football and rolling pin to 3D shapes.
Discussed curved surfaces, circular ends, square faces, and shape staying the same when turned.
Child asked for examples shown from different views; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised 3D shape names, everyday examples, and recognising shapes when they are turned or shown from different sides. Ishita explained the cylinder using a cake tin and rolling pin, distinguished a football from a flat circle, and identified cube and cuboid features using dice and a matchbox. The key method was checking faces, ends, and curved surfaces; no misconception was recorded. At home, ask them to find one cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone, and sphere and explain one feature of each.
